📺 Twisted Metal Seasons 1 & 2, available to stream on Peacock. (2023–Present)

Twisted Metal follows John Doe, a mysterious delivery driver struggling to survive in a dangerous post-apocalyptic world where society has collapsed and heavily armed criminals rule the roads. When John receives an opportunity to secure a better future, he must transport a mysterious package across a lawless wasteland filled with ruthless killers, deadly vehicles, and unpredictable enemies. Along the way, he encounters Quiet, a fearless woman with her own dangerous mission, and Sweet Tooth, a terrifying masked killer who drives an ice cream truck. As John fights to complete his delivery, he becomes caught in explosive battles, shocking betrayals, and deadly competitions. Combining outrageous humor, intense action, and chaotic car chases, the series explores survival, revenge, friendship, and the struggle to find hope in a broken world.

🎬 Main Cast:

* Anthony Mackie as John Doe
* Stephanie Beatriz as Quiet
* Joe Seanoa as Sweet Tooth
* Will Arnett as the Voice of Sweet Tooth
* Thomas Haden Church as Agent Stone
* Neve Campbell as Raven
* Richard Cabral as Loud
* Mike Mitchell as Stu
* Tahj Vaughans as Mike

🎭 Genre: Action • Comedy • Adventure • Post-Apocalyptic

⭐ IMDb: 7.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~25–35 minutes per episode • 2 seasons • 22 episodes

📺 Where to Watch: Peacock (United States) • Streaming availability varies by region
